scientific_role: estimator-policy freeze audit; no H5 reference candidate ranking or parameter fitting performed

decisions.history_halton_mapping: For raw Halton coordinates u7,u11, alpha_search_200=max(u7,u11) and alpha_search_1000=min(u7,u11).

candidate_budgets_per_fold.H5_history: 498 Halton + 1 exact common anchor + 1 exact null anchor

decisions.primary_guard: H5_history beats H5_common_search in >=5/6 folds and has positive median relative held-out improvement.
decisions.exact_null_guard: H5_history beats H5_null in >=5/6 folds and has positive median relative held-out improvement.
decisions.cross_family_guard: Only after own guards pass, H5_history must beat each matched frozen H2/H3/H4 comparator in >=4/6 folds with positive median relative improvement to be called overall development-preferred.

measurement_and_scoring.scorer: corrected H3/H4-compatible 19-quantile W1/training-SD + 2*Hellinger five-category exit scorer
measurement_and_scoring.heldout_geometry_rule: Held-out colony geometry excluded from simulation geometry pool even during held-out simulation generation.
measurement_and_scoring.CRN: Trial seed, geometry draw, entry-transition stream, and H5 dedicated choice/search cadence matched across nested H5 models.

comparator_pins.rule: Frozen fold-specific candidates are re-evaluated under H5 reconstructed geometry and matched held-out scoring; no refitting from H5 outcomes.

implementation_authorization.persistent_H5_runtime: now authorized only as an exact implementation of the frozen mechanism and estimator contract
implementation_authorization.synthetic_qualification: required before any reference candidate search

next_step: Implement the frozen H5 runtime and estimator exactly, then run the required synthetic/no-reference-loss qualification before any high-resolution reference search.
